calculation.expression: momentum_20d(asset) * regime_t, where regime_t=+1 after breadth>=0.60, regime_t=-1 after breadth<=0.40, and regime_t persists within (0.40,0.60)
calculation.description: Compute each tradable asset's trailing 20-day return. Cross-asset breadth is the fraction of valid assets with positive 20-day returns. Activate continuation only when breadth reaches 60%, activate reversal when breadth is at or below 40%, and retain the prior regime in the wider neutral band. Higher scores indicate stronger expected forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 20-day IC in 2020-2021, 2025-2029 and 2031; negative in 2022-2024, 2030 and 2032. Threshold asymmetry modestly improved 20-day IC and turnover versus the prior 55%/45% hysteresis factor. Small 15-asset universe and regime variation require conservative interpretation.
